news.title: New major risk - Market cap size
news.body: The company's market capitalization is less than US$10m. Market cap: ₹929.9m (US$9.96m) This is considered a major risk. Companies with a small market capitalization are most likely businesses that have not yet released a product to market or are simply a very small company without a wide reach. Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. In addition, if the company's size is the main factor, it is less likely to have many investors and analysts following it and scrutinizing its performance and outlook. news.title: Leading Leasing Finance and Investment Company Limited Announces Resignation of Mr. Saumik Arvind Ghervada from Post of Independent Director of the Company with Effect from February 21, 2026
news.body: Leading Leasing Finance and Investment Company Limited announced that Mr. Saumik Arvind Ghervada [DIN: 10859766] has resigned from post of Independent Director of the Company with effect from February 21, 2026 due to pre-occupancy. He has confirmed that there is no material reason for his resignation other than mentioned in his resignation letter.

news.title: Leading Leasing Finance and Investment Company Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 250 million in funding
news.body: Leading Leasing Finance and Investment Company Limited announces a private placement with Bharatbhai ravatbhai khachar, Jilubhai ravatbhai khachar, Jaran jilubhai khachar, Kuldeep bharatbhai khachar to issue 50,000,000 equity shares at a price of INR 5 per share for gross proceeds of INR 250,000,000 on February 16, 2026. It is subject to the approval of the shareholders at Extra-Ordinary General Meeting (“EGM”) and the relevant Stock Exchanges.

news.title: Leading Leasing Finance and Investment Company Limited Appoints Ketankumar Shivabhai Gosai as Chief Financial Officer, Effective February 12, 2026
news.body: Leading Leasing Finance and Investment Company Limited has appointed Mr. Ketankumar Shivabhai Gosai as Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of the Company with effect from February 12, 2026. He is a Commerce Graduate (B. Com) from Sardar Patel University with over 16 years of experience in banking operations across various NBFCs and banking sectors.
